executive_summary: Preserve strengths in breakfast, cleanliness and the broadly positive staff experience while addressing a small set of operational and maintenance frictions that have recently emerged: after-hours reception/reachability, in‑room technology (internet/TV), and bathroom functional issues (clogged drain and decor inconsistency).
